Produce INEH2_dp
Calculate  \( P_{j} = \sum_{i=1}^{m} p_{i,j}, \forall j \in N \) 
 \( \lambda^{LPT} := \text{sort all jobs according to } P_{j} \text{ in decreasing order} \) 
for f := 1 to F do
    \( \pi_{f} := \emptyset \) 
endfor
for step := 1 to n do
    \( j := \lambda^{LPT}[step] \) 
    for f := 1 to F do
    \( P_{insert} := \text{all positions in } \pi_{f} \text{ where job } j \text{ can be inserted} \) 
    \( P_{insert}^{*} := \text{randomly dropout positions from } P_{insert} \text{ with probability } k \) 
    test to insert job j in  \( P_{insert}^{*} \) 
    \( C_{max}^{f} := \text{the lowest makespan obtained} \) 
    \( p_{f}^{f} := \text{the position that generates the } C_{max}^{f} \) 
    endfor
    \( f_{min} := \arg(\min_{f=1}^{F}(C_{max}^{f})) \) 
    Insert job j in factory  \( f_{min} \)  at position  \( p^{f_{min}} \) 
    \( j^{*} := \arg(\min(P_{p^{f_{min}}+1}, P_{p^{f_{min}}-1})) \) 
    Test to swap job  \( j^{*} \)  with all jobs in factory  \( f_{min} \) 
    Swap job  \( j^{*} \)  with the job resulting in the lowest makespan
endfor

Procedure Destruction ( \( \Pi=(\pi_{1},\pi_{2},..., \pi_{F}) \) )
 \( \lambda_{d} := \varnothing \) 
for step := 1 to d do
    \( f_{1}, f_{2} := \) randomly select two factories
    if ( \( C_{max}(\pi_{f_{1}}) > C_{max}(\pi_{f_{2}}) \) ) then
    j := randomly remove one job from  \( \pi_{f_{1}} \) 
    else
    j := randomly remove one job from  \( \pi_{f_{2}} \) 
    endif
    Append job j to  \( \lambda_{d} \) 
endfor
return  \( \lambda_{d} \) 
Fig 5. Procedure of the destruction phase.

Procedure Construction( \( \Pi=(\pi_{1},\pi_{2},..., \pi_{F}),\lambda_{d} \) )
 \( \lambda_{d}^{LPT} := \text{sort jobs in } \lambda_{d} \text{ according to } P_{j} \text{ in decreasing order} \) 
for step := 1 to d do
    \( j := \lambda_{d}^{LPT}[step] \) 
    for f := 1 to F do
    Test job j in all possible positions in  \( \pi_{f} \) 
    \( C_{max}^{f} := \text{the lowest makespan obtained} \) 
    \( p^{f} := \text{the position that generates the } C_{max}^{f} \) 
    endfor
    \( f_{min} := \arg(\min_{f=1}^{F}(C_{max}^{f})) \) 
    Insert job j in factory  \( f_{min} \)  at position  \( p^{f_{min}} \) 
    \( j^{*} := \arg(\min(P_{p^{f_{min}}+1}, P_{p^{f_{min}}-1})) \) 
    for f := 1 to F do
    Test to swap job  \( j^{*} \)  with all jobs in  \( \pi_{f} \) 
    \( C_{max}^{f} := \text{the lowest makespan obtained} \) 
    \( j^{f} := \text{the job that generates the } C_{max}^{f} \) 
    endfor
    \( f_{min} := \arg(\min_{f=1}^{F}(C_{max}^{f})) \) 
    Swap job  \( j^{*} \)  with  \( j^{f_{min}} \)  in  \( \pi_{f_{min}} \) 
endfor

Procedure ISLS( \( \Pi=(\pi_{1},\pi_{2},..., \pi_{F}) \) )

for f := 1 to F do

    for i := 1 to number of jobs in  \( \pi_{f} \)  do

    randomly select a job j from  \( \pi_{f} \)  without repetition

    \( C_{max}^{ref} := C_{max}(\pi_{f}) \) 

    Test to swap job j with all other jobs in  \( \pi_{f} \) 

    \( C_{max} := \)  the lowest makespan obtained

    \( j^{*} := \)  the job that generates the  \( C_{max} \) 

    if ( \( C_{max}^{ref} > C_{max} \) ) do

    Swap job j with  \( j^{*} \) 

    break

    endif

    endfor

endfor

Procedure ESLS( \( \Pi=(\pi_{1},\pi_{2},..., \pi_{F}) \) )

 \( C_{max}^{*} := \max_{f=1}^{F}(C_{max}(\pi_{1}),C_{max}(\pi_{2}),...,C_{max}(\pi_{F})) \) 

 \( f_{key} := \text{the factory yielding } C_{max}^{*} \) 

for i := 1 to number of jobs in  \( \pi_{f_{key}} \)  do

    randomly select a job j from  \( \pi_{f_{key}} \)  without repetition

    for f := 1 to F do

    Test to swap job j with all jobs in  \( \pi_{f} \) 

    \( C_{max}^{f} := \text{the lowest makespan obtained} \) 

    \( j^{f} := \text{the job that generates the } C_{max}^{f} \) 

    endfor

    \( C_{max} := \min_{f=1}^{F}(C_{max}^{f}) \) 

    if  \( C_{max} < C_{max}^{*} \)  then

    \( f_{min} := \arg(C_{max}) \) 

    Swap job j with  \( j^{f_{min}} \)  in  \( \pi_{f_{min}} \) 

    break

    endif

endfor

Procedure EILS( \( \Pi=(\pi_{1},\pi_{2},..., \pi_{F}) \) )
 \( C_{max}^{*}:=\max_{f=1}^{F}(C_{max}(\pi_{1}),C_{max}(\pi_{2}),...,C_{max}(\pi_{F})) \) 
 \( f_{key}:=the factory yielding C_{max}^{*} \) 
for i := 1 to number of jobs in  \( \pi_{f_{key}} \)  do
    randomly extract a job j from  \( \pi_{f_{key}} \)  without repetition
    for f := 1 to F do
    Test to insert job j into all positions in  \( \pi_{f} \) 
    \( C_{max}^{f}:=the lowest makespan obtained \) 
    \( p^{f}:=the position that generates the C_{max}^{f} \) 
    endfor
    \( C_{max}:=\min_{f=1}^{F}(C_{max}^{f}) \) 
    if  \( C_{max}<C_{max}^{*} \)  then
    \( f_{min}:=\arg(C_{max}) \) 
    Insert job j into  \( \pi_{f_{min}} \)  at position  \( p^{f_{min}} \) 
    break
    else then
    Return job j to the original position
    endif
endfor

Procedure MSIG for PM/DPFSP
 \( \Pi_{best} := \text{INEH2}() \) 
while (termination criterion not satisfied) do
    c := 0
    \( \Pi := \text{INEH2}() \) 
    while (c <  \( \alpha \) ) do
    \( \Pi^{*} := \Pi \) 
    \( \lambda_{d} := \text{Destruction}(\Pi^{*}) \) 
    Construction( \( \Pi^{*}, \lambda_{d} \) )
    LocalSearch( \( \Pi^{*} \) )
    if ( \( C_{max}(\Pi^{*}) < C_{max}(\Pi) \) ) then
    \( \Pi := \Pi^{*} \) 
    else if (random ≤ exp(- \( \frac{C_{max}(\Pi^{*}) - C_{max}(\Pi)}{\text{Temperature}} \) )) then
    \( \Pi := \Pi^{*} \) 
    else then
    \( \Pi^{*} := \Pi \) 
    endif
    if ( \( C_{max}(\Pi^{*}) < C_{max}(\Pi_{best}) \) ) then
    \( \Pi_{best} := \Pi^{*} \) 
    c := 0
    else then
    c := c + 1
    endif
    endwhile
endwhile
return  \( \Pi_{best} \)
